issue_context.title: Missing AC Operations and Fan Mode
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Until recently, the MyAir integration correctly showed 5 operations. 
Including Heat, Cool, Fan, Dry, Off. Fan and Dry are now missing.

Fan mode has been a little buggy in the past with using Auto in scenes.
Now Auto fan mode is missing as an option completely.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2023.5.3

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Advantage Air

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/advantage_air

### Diagnostics information

Attempted to download - got failed - server problem

Ok I might have missed FAN in certain operating modes. It should be there in MyZone, but I have a feeling MyAuto doesn't support it intentionally.

I enabled the myfan option on the tablet, reloaded the integration, and auto fan mode now shows in HA.

![PXL_20230516_070623554](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/98076159/58890f95-fab5-4186-8d5c-eb03946dd024)

This issue is mainly regarding the operating modes of dry and fan - both of which I had automation for using.

![PXL_20230516_071321666](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/98076159/2e4ab59d-978e-41dc-ab02-b594347c721e)
@sEdsKi Thank you for confirming this with pictures, thats super helpful, I'll raise a PR to add fan and dry back in now for MyTemp.

review_comments: You could add here `_attr_supported_features = ClimateEntityFeature.FAN_MODE` since this is supported on all cases.
